description_ru: Organic deposits: peat and muck up to 2 m; bogs; permafrost common with palsas and ice-wedge polygons

description_ru: Alluvial deposits: gravel to silt 1-5 m; floodplains
Glaciolacustrine deposits: silt and sand 1-8 m
Glaciofluvial outwash: rounded gravel and sand < 5 m; braided fans
Glaciofluvial esker sediments: sand silt gravel 1-40 m; ridges mounds aprons
Till veneer < 2 m; includes patches of bedrock and till blanket
